Name: Waters of Jericho
Description: The Waters of Jericho were the spring waters at Jericho, named as a boundary point of Benjamin, and remembered as the waters Elisha healed when the men of the city told him the water was bad and the ground barren.
BiblicalSignificance: The waters are the spring Elisha healed with salt in a new cruse: bad water made wholesome at the city Joshua had cursed.
